name: labs/pangea567__gnsdo-scpi-simulator
title: Jackson Labs Low Noise Rubidium GNSDO
intro: Jackson Labs Low Noise Rubidium GNSDO, adapted from pangea567/gnsdo-scpi-simulator. It reads `identity`, `sync_locked`, `tint`, `health` and 14 more; runs `start_holdover`, `recover_from_holdover`, `set_sync_source` and `set_ptime_output`. `start_holdover`: put the oscillator into holdover (the device keeps the last known frequency without GPS). A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
